ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a secondary high-intensity (white) scatter; estimated ratio of 8:1 dark to light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density scattering of discrete white circular micro-blobs across the right lobe mid-to-distal region; lower density scattering on the left lobe proximal to the notch. Concentrated high-intensity clusters mapped at the distal terminal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central aperture angle of approximately 105 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth relative to horizontal span estimated at 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; characterized by jagged peak-to-valley transitions with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitting the superior boundaries of both lobes, tapering to pointed terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel patterns concentrated at the extreme distal ends of the left and right lobes, exhibiting high contrast against the dark base pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white disruptions visible as vertical rake marks on the medial portion of the left lobe and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and deep notching on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense white calloused clusters at the terminal tips indicating potential past trauma or colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'starfield' pigmentation pattern consisting of thousands of discrete high-intensity white points scattered across the dark ventral surface.
